Thomas Patel
QA Automation Engineer | Hyderabad, Telangana
thomas.patel560@example.com | +91 9881498232

Motivated QA Automation Engineer with a focus on web application quality and test reliability. Proven track record designing and executing automated test suites, integrating tests into CI pipelines, and reducing manual regression time. Comfortable collaborating with product and engineering teams in Agile environments; available with a 60 days notice period.

Experience

Swiggy — Jun 2024 - Jul 2026
QA Automation Engineer, On-site
- Built and maintained Selenium-based regression suites for core order flow, increasing automated coverage from 22% to 68% and reducing nightly false positives by 45%.
- Implemented Cypress end-to-end tests for the restaurant onboarding web portal, cutting manual regression time by 60% and accelerating release validation to 1.5 hours.
- Standardized TestNG test structure and reporting across multiple teams, enabling consistent test execution in CI and decreasing build-to-deploy time by 30%.

Paystack India — Oct 2023 - May 2024
QA Automation Engineer, Hybrid
- Developed TestNG-driven automation for payment gateway flows using Selenium, validating 15+ payment scenarios and identifying critical edge-case bugs prior to production.
- Introduced Cypress component tests for merchant dashboard widgets, improving UI stability metrics and reducing UI-related incidents by 35%.
- Collaborated with product and engineering in Jira-managed sprints to triage defects and prioritize automation for high-risk payment features.

Cognizant — Feb 2023 - Sep 2023
QA Automation Engineer, Remote
- Created Selenium WebDriver suites for an enterprise portal, automating 120+ smoke and regression cases and enabling daily automated sanity checks.
- Wrote Cypress end-to-end tests for customer-facing workflows and integrated tests with Jenkins pipelines to run on every merge, catching regressions earlier.
- Implemented TestNG test grouping and Java-based utilities to parameterize tests across environments, improving test reusability and execution speed.

Projects
- Checkout Flow Stabilizer: Automated a cross-browser test matrix using Selenium and TestNG to validate checkout permutations; reduced flaky failures by 40% through targeted retries and selectors improvement.
- Dashboard Component Tests: Built Cypress test suites for reusable UI components used across merchant dashboards, enabling stable releases and faster UI iteration.
